notes: DeepFlux 9.8 - the YouTube downloader can now update itself in-app: when a YouTube change breaks downloads, DeepFlux offers an approved newer yt-dlp with one click (from the notice or Settings -> Download Manager), or installs it automatically if you switch that on. Every release is digest-verified and passes a start-up safety check before use, and you can always revert to the bundled version. Includes all 9.0-9.7 features.
